text:
sec-bot: ALERT: supply-chain scanner detected HIGH severity vulnerability CVE-2025-8147 in transitive dependency 'trim-parse' used by image redwood/builder:v2026-03-15. SBOM layer checksum mismatch vs provenance. https://scans.internal/redwood/5482 :warning:

maria: Ack, triage starting. Which clusters/images pulled that builder image in the last 48h? Any prod hits?

josh: Quick grep - saw two CI runs that produced images with that builder tag. Run this to list recent pulls: `gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood-builder/redwood/builder --filter="timestamp>2026-03-10" --format="get(digest, tags, timestamp)"`

lee: CI logs show one deploy to staging and one canary to prod at 03:17 UTC yesterday. I pulled a snippet from the builder job: 
```
ERROR: cosign sign failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = signer: kms:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/builder-keys/cryptoKeys/cosign-key: permission denied
```
so artifact signing never completed for that run. SBOM pushed but signature missing.

oliver: Confirmed. The transitive dep was introduced by a minor bump in `web-templates@2.4.1` -> `trim-parse@1.8.0`. Patch available at upstream but not yet pulled into our lockfiles.

maria: Containment proposal (short):
1) Prevent further deploys built with redwood/builder:v2026-03-15: mark image as quarantined in registry and block new pulls.
2) Disable auto-rebuild pipeline that picks latest builder images.
3) Roll back the one prod canary to previous stable (if metrics look bad) and pause further rollouts.
4) Require manual approval + sec sign-off for any rebuild/redeploy of images using that builder.

josh: For registry quarantine: run `gcloud artifacts repositories set-iam-policy` to temporarily remove `artifactregistry.reader` for default compute SA, then add back to a restricted list. Or simpler: add a deny policy at the proxy layer for digest `sha256:...` until we rebuild. I'll open a short-lived ACL.

lee: RBAC change request: create a temporary role `artifact.quarantine_approver` granted to `sec-team@redwood.com` and `platform-oncall@redwood.com` with only `artifacts.quarantine` and `artifacts.approve_rebuild`. We'll add an audit log sink to export `artifact.*` events to bigquery for retrospective. Approver role -> manual approval step in CI pipeline.

oliver: SBOM/KMS follow-up: we should require cosign verification during deploy and fail fast if signature missing. Steps:
- Rebuild affected image with patched deps/pinned lockfile.
- Generate SBOM with `syft` and attach to artifact metadata.
- Sign both image and SBOM with cosign -> KMS: `COSIGN_KMS=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/builder-keys/cryptoKeys/cosign-key cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KMS gcr.io/.../redwood/builder@sha256:...`

maria: Can we automate SBOM verification? We should add: `cosign verify --key $KMS_REF` and `syft diff` check in deploy job. If either fails, fail the deploy.

josh: Agreed. Also add a CI check that blocks merges that modify `package-lock.json` without an approvals label from `sec-team` for buildpack repos.

lee: Draft of incident comms (short): "We observed a high-severity transitive dependency CVE affecting one builder image. We have quarantined the image, disabled automatic rebuilds, and are rebuilding signed images with a patched dependency. No evidence of exploit so far; investigation ongoing. Will post updates every hour. Contact sec@redwood.com for impact questions." :loudspeaker:

oliver: Mitigation options:
- Fast path: pin to previous dependency tree and rebuild image -> sign and promote.
- Fix path: bump `web-templates` to patched version and rebuild, run full integration tests, then sign.
- If upstream patch delayed, vendor/fork the minimal fix and publish internal patch & release.

maria: Post-incident checklist:
- Owner: oliver -> rebuild + sign patched images within 4h.
- Owner: josh -> implement registry deny and short-lived RBAC rules within 1h.
- Owner: lee -> add cosign verification to deploy pipeline and create audit sink within 8h.
- Owner: sec-team -> run impact sweep across org (search for images built with same base) within 2h.
- Follow-up: schedule a retro with Platform, Sec, and SRE tomorrow.

sec-bot: Created ticket INC-5482 in security tracker, severity P2. Labels: supply-chain, sbom, cosign, rbac. Assigned: oliver, josh, lee. Next update due 1765880723.

maria: thanks all. I'll start the owner threads and ping #incidents after we confirm quarantined digest. :thumbsup:
